title: Even stupendous black holes can’t explain dark matter
title_zh: 即使是巨型黑洞也无法解释暗物质
abstract: The theoretical objects would have left a larger imprint on cosmic radiation if they were a source of the invisible force pulling together the galaxies.
abstract_zh: 如果这些理论对象是将星系拉在一起的无形引力之源，那么它们在宇宙辐射上会留下更大的印记。
snippet: The theoretical objects would have left a larger imprint on cosmic radiation if they were a source of the invisible force pulling together the galaxies.
